America's Aging Air Travel Infrastructure Isn't Ready for Climate-Fuelled Extreme Weather

The U.S. is still reeling from a nationwide ground stop last Friday—the longest such flight stoppage in 25 years—which lasted more than four hours and resulted in more than 15,000 delayed or cancelled flights. And with Thanksgiving only a week away, the year’s busiest travel season is about to begin—bringing with it anxieties of further disruption .
